The '''Zaloriis system''' was located in the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], which served as the site of the development of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. The planet's [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorian]] inhabitants rebelled against the Empire prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], but were [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|defeated]].

==Description==
The Zaloriis system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the desolate [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]].<ref name="GB" /> Through the [[Nanth'ri Trade Route/Legends|Nanth'ri Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], the Zaloriis system was connected to<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Hasaq system/Legends|Hasaq]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous]] and [[Attahox system/Legends|Attahox systems]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Zaloriis proved to be less than equal to the task of resisting Vader's will.|[[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|audio=ZaloriisWeak.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Battle of Zaloriis.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Galactic Empire eliminated the Rebels on Zaloriis.]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] secretly developed the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] on Zaloriis under the direction of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. Later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Zalorian Separatists]] under the leadership of [[Zalor Minister]] [[Transe Decar]] sought independence from the Empire, joining forces with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="GB" /> of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was searching for the hidden [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel base]] and traveled to Zaloriis to investigate why the planet's [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] tribute to the Empire had gone unpaid. He entered the Zaloriis system with his [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], along with another [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], a host of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], and a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. On Zaloriis, Vader's force discovered the Rebel presence and [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|destroyed]] it. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and Veers afterward departed the system.<ref name="GB" />

==Inhabitants==
Zaloriis was home to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] population called the [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorians]], who [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zaloriis system first appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" /> It was identified in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-12 as part of the Expansion Region,<ref name="TEA" /> overriding ''Galactic Battlegrounds'', which stated that Zaloriis was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GB" />
